profiles.everyoneInYourHousehold: Each household profile has its own watch history and Continue Watching. An optional PIN protects profile switching.
profiles.theHomePageFor: The home page for profiles that haven't arranged their own
profiles.shareLibrariesWithSomeone: Share libraries with someone outside your household
profiles.peopleOutsideYourHousehold: Friends have their own sign-in and see only the libraries you share. Remote access must be configured before they can connect from outside your network.
profiles.noFriendsYetAdd: No friends yet. Add Friend makes an invite link to send them.
profiles.aNewLinkLets: A new link lets them choose a new password
profiles.aNewInviteLink: A new invite link (the old one stops working)
profiles.theirWatchHistoryAnd: Their watch history and Continue Watching are deleted. This can't be undone, except by restoring a backup.
profiles.sendThemThisLink: Send them this link. With it they choose a password, then sign in with their name and password. It works once, for 7 days.
profiles.thisLinkUsesYour: This link uses a local network address. For a friend elsewhere, configure Remote access under Settings → Access & devices, then open Arc at its external address and create the invite there.
profiles.chooseWhatTheyCan: Choose what they can watch. Next you'll get an invite link to send them.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.aPinIsNeeded: A PIN is needed to use this profile.
profiles.titlesWithoutAnAge: Titles without an age rating are hidden too. You can add a rating with Edit on its page.
profiles.thisProfileWonT: This profile won't see anything until you choose a library.
profiles.addLabelsToTitles: Add labels to titles with Edit on their page.
profiles.adminWithoutPin: Anyone can use this profile. At home, the admin profile asks for the password instead.

backups.backUpAndRestore: Back up and restore Arc's database. Your media files are never part of a backup and are never changed.
backups.databaseBackupsAndFull: Database backups and full server recovery
backups.backUpNowSaves: Back Up Now saves library matches, edits, episode orders, profiles, settings and watch history. It does not include uploaded artwork, certificates or optimized videos.
backups.forAFullServer: For a full server backup, stop Arc and copy its entire data folder to separate storage (/config in Docker). Keep your media and any externally configured files separately, and retain the matching Arc version.
backups.restoringADatabaseBackup: Restoring a database backup does not restore or roll back those separate files. Previously uploaded artwork may be unavailable if its image file is no longer present.
backups.arcIsNotTaking: Arc is not taking automatic daily backups.
backups.backUpNowAnd: Back Up Now and safety backups before updates, restores or library removals remain available when automatic backups are Off.
backups.useBackUpNow: Use Back Up Now to save your database. Automatic backups follow the status and maintenance policy above.
backups.yourCurrentDatabaseIs: Your current database is saved first, so you can switch back. Uploaded artwork, certificates and optimized videos are not restored or rolled back. Your media files aren't touched.
backups.allDaySchedule: Daily backups run when due during maintenance: all day (server local time). They may wait while playback or scanning is active.
backups.windowSchedule: Daily backups run when due during maintenance: {{window}} (server local time). They may wait while playback or scanning is active.
backups.folderDescription: Arc keeps the last 7 daily backups plus one a week for the 4 weeks before that. Backups you make yourself are kept until you delete them. They're stored in <folder>{{folder}}</folder>.
backups.restoreDescription: Arc will go back to how it was on <date>{{date}}</date>: the saved database, including matches, edits, episode orders, profiles, settings and watch history. Database changes made since then will be undone.
backups.deleteDescription: The backup from {{date}} will be permanently deleted.
backups.restoredNotice: Restored the backup from {{date}}. Your libraries are being rescanned.
